name: Alarm
description:
Casting time: 1 minute.

You ward against unwanted intrusion. Choose a door, window, or an area no larger than 20 ft in any dimension. For the next day, you are alerted whenever a creature touches the warded object or enters the warded area. When you cast the spell, you may designate creatures that do not trigger the alarm.

Choose whether the alarm is audible or mental:

  • Audible: The alarm produces a sound of your choosing, audible within long range.

  • Mental: You are alerted in your mind and awakened if sleeping.

Describe how you cast the ward.

improvements.name: Greater Alarm
improvements.description: You may instead spend 8 hours casting this spell to extend to maximum dimension of the warded area to 100 ft and make its effects last for 1 year.
